descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在泉州吃过面线糊后画的小菜单。碗里留了几根细线，旁边那颗圆圆的是我选的卤蛋。
descriptions.en: My drawing after a bowl of mee sua soup in Quanzhou. A few fine lines stand for the noodles; the round parcel beside them is my braised egg.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在泉州吃过润饼菜后留下的画。薄饼皮卷着馅料，我在旁边添了一个小箭头，提醒纸上的那卷别自己松开。
descriptions.en: Drawn after trying runbing in Quanzhou. The thin wrapper holds the fillings; an arrow asks my paper version to stay rolled up.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在泉州画开元寺东西塔时，把第一座画得太大，只好给纸边接一小条。这是我自己留的笨办法，倒让两座塔都有了位置。
descriptions.en: My Kaiyuan twin-pagoda sketch needed an extra strip after I drew the first tower too large. A homemade solution, with room for both at last.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在泉州吃润饼菜时，我用干净便纸比划了一回卷法。纸上没有配方，只有一个提醒自己扶住纸卷的箭头。
descriptions.en: A clean sheet I rolled while sketching runbing in Quanzhou. No recipe, just an arrow showing where my uncooperative paper needed a hand.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在泉州洛阳桥边把分水尖和信封角画在一起。后来只给信封添了腿，免得纸上的桥也跟着出发。
descriptions.en: At Luoyang Bridge in Quanzhou, I drew a cutwater beside an envelope corner. Only the envelope received legs; the bridge had better stay put.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在泉州，我和两位旅人把三张便纸接起来画开元寺东西塔。画中的小路是我们随手添的，三个背包小身影却都被说成是我。
descriptions.en: Two travelers and I joined three sheets after seeing the Kaiyuan twin pagodas in Quanzhou. We invented the little path ourselves, then somehow all three backpacked figures became me.
